info.title: Embedding Atlas data API
info.summary: Keyless, CORS-open JSON and CSV over public water, trade, jobs and housing sources, with provenance on every number.
info.description: Every JSON response is an envelope: route-specific fields at the top level, the payload in `data`, one `provenance` record per upstream release the numbers came from (estimates carry their formula in `method`), and `generatedAt`. Tabular ops answer `format=csv` with the same provenance as `#` comment lines after the data. See docs/API.md for citation format, caching, courtesy and per-source revision caveats.

get.description: One route, dispatched on `op`. Bounding boxes are clamped to 18° and snapped outward to a 1° grid so nearby callers share a cache entry. Tabular ops (`areas`, `sectors`, `ports`, `border`, `countries`, `pulse`) accept `format=csv`.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: areas: counties in a bbox (or every state with level=state) joined with QCEW jobs/wages and Zillow home values/rents. sectors: NAICS sector mix for a county (SSCCC) or state (SS000) with location quotients. context: sector mix plus metro, state and US home values. ports: World Port Index harbours in a bbox with BTS Port Performance volumes. border: every US land port of entry with 25 months of BTS counts. countries: Natural Earth polygons with World Bank GDP, exports, imports, trade/GDP, TEU. partners: top trading partners (WITS). pulse: national FRED and BTS series. report: the market report for a point.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: `w,s,e,n` degrees. Required for op=areas (level=county) and op=ports.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: op=areas: county polygons in the bbox, or every state.

parameters.name: fips
parameters.description: op=sectors, op=context: county GEOID (48453) or state (48000).

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: op=ports: smallest harbour size to include; any harbour with BTS statistics is always included.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: op=pulse with format=csv: long format, one row per observation instead of one per series.

200.description: Envelope for the op, or CSV.

text/csv.example:
geoid,name,level,state,...
48453,Travis,county,TX,...
# generated_at: 2026-09-11T10:00:00.000Z
# source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages. ...

get.description: One route, dispatched on `op`. Bounding boxes are clamped to 4° and snapped outward to a 0.5° grid. Tabular ops (`gauges`, `wells`, `nwps`, `twdb`, `history`, `matchup`) accept `format=csv`.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: gauges: USGS latest continuous readings in a bbox (flow, stage, temperature, DO, conductance, pH, turbidity, reservoir elevation/storage). wells: USGS latest daily groundwater levels with aquifer names. nwps: NOAA NWPS gauges with flood categories. twdb: Texas reservoirs. drought: US Drought Monitor current polygons. history: 365 days of daily means for one site and parameter. matchup: instantaneous values for one site and parameter in a window. report: the community water report for a point.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: `w,s,e,n` degrees. Required for op=gauges, wells, nwps.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: USGS parameter code(s). op=gauges: optional comma list to narrow; op=history, op=matchup: one code, required.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: op=matchup: window start, ISO 8601 with Z.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: op=matchup: window end, ISO 8601 with Z.

200.description: Envelope for the op, or CSV.

format.name: format
format.description: csv is offered on the tabular ops only; other ops answer 400. `Accept: text/csv` works too.

CacheControl.description: `public, max-age=0, s-maxage=<ttl>, stale-while-revalidate=<ttl>`: browsers revalidate, the CDN edge absorbs repeats for the op's TTL (5 min for live gauges, hours for monthly and quarterly tables).

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or malformed; `error` says what a valid call looks like.

Upstream.description: An upstream did not answer; `upstream` and `status` name it.

id.description: Stable id from lib/provenance/sources.ts, e.g. bls-qcew, zillow-zhvi, usgs-water.

seriesId.description: Upstream series / file / site:parameter when one exists (MORTGAGE30US, County_zhvi_...csv, USGS-08180800:00060).

period.description: What the value describes: ISO date, 2026-07, 2026-Q1, 2024, or from/to.

releasedAt.description: When the upstream published it, when known.

retrievedAt.description: When this server fetched it (cache age subtracted).

kind.description: published = relayed as-is; estimate = computed here from published values (see method); snapshot = our own observation of a live feed.

method.description: For estimates: the formula that ran, with the inputs.

revision.description: Upstream revision policy or flag (provisional, revised, ...).

data.description: The payload; shape depends on the op.

source.description: Short human label of the upstreams (kept for older scripts).

cacheAge.description: Milliseconds since the server fetched the cached table (0 = fresh).

Envelope.description: Route-specific fields (bbox, level, asOf, globe, ...) sit beside these at the top level.

details.description: Human-readable key/values as the HUD shows them.

extra.description: Layer-specific payload: AreaExtra (jobs, home, rent), PortExtra (wpi, stats), CrossingExtra (measures), CountryExtra (wb), GaugeExtra (readings, screens, index, flood), WellExtra, ReservoirExtra, DroughtExtra.

JobsRow.description: BLS QCEW row, all ownerships, all industries. Suppressed cells are null.

lq.description: Employment location quotient vs the nation.

id.description: FRED series id, or bts-* for BTS indicators.

basis.description: Prose: what the numbers are and are not.

estimate.description: Payment, wage share, price-to-rent, years of wages and the formula lines.

momentum.description: Estimate: weighted mean of normalised over-the-year terms with the formula printed.

provenance.description: Union of every section's provenance, de-duplicated.

citations.description: One citation line per provenance record.

globe.description: Permalink that opens the same point on the globe.

data.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; each feature's properties.DM is the class 0-4.
